parameters.question: Compare NMF W matrices (samples x 3 metagenes) from NMF(n_components=3, init='nndsvda') on log2(x+1)-transformed gene expression. Each sample's metagene activation scores must match the reference within +/-0.05 absolute; column order and component label naming may differ, so align components by matching value patterns across samples, and align rows by sample ID.

Compare NMF gene loadings (H matrix, n_components=3, init='nndsvda') from log2(x+1)-transformed expression data. Each gene's loading value must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error; metagene row order and gene column order may differ.
